bio: Hilda Lucia Solis (; born October 20, 1957) is an American politician and member-elect of the United States House of Representatives for the 38th congressional district of California. Solis is the outgoing member of the Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors for the 1st district and is the Chair of Los Angeles County. Solis previously served as the 25th United States Secretary of Labor from 2009 to 2013, as part of the administration of President Barack Obama.
offices: Member of the California State Assembly (1992–1994)
Member of the State Senate of California (1994–2000)
Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors (2014–present)
